title: Add plan re-confirmation step on plan changes in ticket-do
story: As a developer, I want the agent to re-confirm the updated plan with me whenever the plan changes mid-execution, so that I always have visibility and approval before implementation continues.
acceptance_criteria: ticket-do instructs the agent to re-present the full updated plan whenever a change is made mid-execution
The agent waits for explicit user confirmation before continuing after a plan change
The re-confirmation step is identical in form to the initial plan confirmation step

title: Replace LLM-driven verbatim field entry in ticket-do with explicit instruction
story: As a developer, I want verbatim text I provide to be placed into ticket fields exactly as given, without the agent interpreting or acting on it, so that data entry is reliable.
acceptance_criteria: ticket-do explicitly instructs the agent to treat user-provided verbatim text as inert data to be transcribed, not as instructions to act on
The agent asks for confirmation before taking any action when the user is in the middle of providing field values
The ticket field contains the exact text the user provided, with no modifications, interpretations, or additions by the agent.

title: Local script to retrieve next ticket number
story: As a developer, I want a local script that retrieves the next ticket number so that I don't contribute towards LLM API usage limits.

title: Script to record user retro feedback verbatim
story: As a developer, I want a script to record my retro feedback directly into the ticket JSON so that the LLM cannot interpret or act on it.
acceptance_criteria: A script exists that accepts a ticket ID and prompts for user_retro text via stdin
The script writes the input verbatim to the user_retro field of the matching ticket in current-sprint.json
The retro command instructs the agent to invoke this script for collecting user_retro rather than asking in chat

title: Route behavioral fixes to the relevant skill during retro
story: As a developer, I want the retro skill to prompt me to update the relevant skill directly when a behavioral problem is identified, so that the fix takes effect immediately rather than becoming a ticket that may never be actioned.

title: As a developer, i want my agents to be able to get the current iso timestamp for including in ticket fields like groomed_at
acceptance_criteria: there is a skill or script that agents can run to determine the current iso-format timestamp
agents have access to the skill or script when they would need it to populate relevant fields in tickets

title: As a developer I want a script/skill/workflow that automatically uses the rest of my daily claude limit as efficiently as possible
acceptance_criteria: There is a new skill/script/command/workflow that runs this new pattern.
The new entity analyzes remaining daily claude limits and develops a plan of how to use the remaining daily usage as efficiently as possible
Planned usage can be towards refactoring, product updates, workflow improvement suggestions, web/codebase research, and claude workflow improvements.
Changes to the codebase should be isolated to different branches

A summary should be written out (location tbd) on the plan, what actually happened, any issues/bottlenecks/things to improve for next time, and names of the newly created branches and what they contain.

title: Track agent metrics per ticket
story: As a developer, I want relevant agent metrics recorded on each ticket so that I can spot trends and improve my agent usage over time.
acceptance_criteria: Each ticket has an agent_metrics field containing: input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_tokens, thinking_tokens, estimated_cost_usd, turn_count, tool_call_count
Metrics accumulate across multiple sessions on the same ticket (values are added, not replaced)
Metrics are updated at the end of any Claude Code session where a ticket is in_progress
Metrics are not updated when no ticket is in_progress
Metrics are updated when a ticket is marked done

title: As a developer, i'd like to be able to close a ticket without adding it to the current sprint
